subject: Invoice setup & payment path for Cumulus Health / Redwood Inference
messages:
From: Anna Lopez <anna@cumulushealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Cumulus AP <ap@cumulushealth.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 16:08:00 -0400
Subject: Billing kickoff: invoice creation & delivery preference

Hi Evelyn / Ben,

Thanks again for the productive kickoff today. Finance at Cumulus needs to confirm how Redwood will issue invoices so our AP stack can accept them automatically. Quick questions to help us set up: 

- Do you prefer we send a PDF invoice to ap@cumulushealth.com with a copy to your billing contact, or would Redwood prefer us to upload invoices directly to your billing portal/API?
- Can you confirm the remit-to address and the billing contact name/email we should use on the invoice?
- Any required tax identifiers we need on the invoice (EIN / VAT)? We have your W-9 on file but want to be sure the invoice includes the right fields for matching.
- Will Redwood accept PO# 45123 on the invoice and Net 30 payment terms?

I attached the signed SOW and our W-9 for your records. We can pilot a manual emailed invoice for May and then switch to portal delivery if that’s easiest.

Best,
Anna Lopez
Head of Procurement
Cumulus Health
anna@cumulushealth.com

Attachments: Cumulus_SOW_v1.pdf (application/pdf); W-9_Cumulus_Signed.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Anna Lopez <anna@cumulushealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Billing kickoff: invoice creation & delivery preference

Anna — thanks for the note and the attachments. Internal accounting notes below and a couple of asks so we can hand this to ops cleanly.

Short answers: we prefer an e-invoice via our billing portal (preferred) but we can accept a PDF emailed to ap@redwood-invoice.com as a fallback for the first month. Please include PO# 45123 on the invoice. Net 30 is fine.

Can you add the following on the invoice so our AR team can auto-match:
- Billing contact: Evelyn Hart, evelyn_hart@redwood.com
- Company/legal name: Redwood Inference, Inc.
- Remit-to: Redwood Inference, Inc. / 410 Pine St, Suite 200, San Francisco, CA 94104
- Tax ID (EIN): 27-1234567

Operational asks:
1) If you can upload to the portal, please send us the portal account ID or the integration contact so we can provision and whitelist Cumulus IPs.
2) If sending PDFs, please use PDF/A where possible and include the PO number in the filename (e.g., INV_45123_Cumulus.pdf).

Ben — looping you in to coordinate the initial invoice receipt and to confirm the accounting code we'll use for this deal. Marcus — tagging you for approval on accepting emailed invoices as fallback for month one only.

Thanks — I’ll confirm once AP has accepted the sample invoice.

—
Evelyn Hart
Sr. Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
evelyn_hart@redwood.com
(415) 555-0198

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Anna Lopez <anna@cumulushealth.com>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Billing kickoff: invoice creation & delivery preference

Approved on our end to accept a one-time emailed invoice as a kickoff exception so onboarding can proceed without delay. A few quick guardrails:

- Emailed invoices ok for May only. From June onwards we need portal/e-invoice intake.
- Please ensure the PDF has an embedded machine-readable PO# and the total broken down by line item (SaaS subscription, overage tokens, one-time onboarding).
- Finance will require the W-9 and signed SOW (attached by Anna) to be present on the first invoice for our vendor setup.

Ben — assign AR code SKU: RD-ENT-2027, and confirm once you’ve added the vendor record. Evelyn — once AP sends the sample invoice, forward to finance@redwood.com with subject line: "New vendor: Cumulus Health — Invoice 45123".

Marcus
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com

From: Anna Lopez <anna@cumulushealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Cumulus AP <ap@cumulushealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Billing kickoff: invoice creation & delivery preference

Evelyn / Marcus / Ben — great, thanks for the fast turnaround and the guardrails.

We will:
- Send an emailed PDF invoice (INV_45123_Cumulus.pdf) to ap@redwood-invoice.com with a copy to evelyn_hart@redwood.com by EOD May 31 to cover the initial onboarding charges.
- Begin provisioning for e-invoice/portal delivery with your billing integrations team next week — I’ll follow up with the integration contact and a test file.
- Include the PO# on the file name and in an XML snippet in the PDF metadata for auto-matching.

Attached: PO_45123.pdf (application/pdf). Will also attach W-9 again with the first invoice.

Thanks — looking forward to a smooth launch.

Anna
Anna Lopez
Head of Procurement, Cumulus Health
anna@cumulushealth.com
